verdict.rationale: Devin CLI's Adaptive mode is documented as an intelligent model router that analyzes each prompt and automatically selects the best model, and users can override it with /model at any time. The evidence is first-party docs only, scoped to the CLI. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of routing quality, documentation of which models are in the routing pool and what criteria are used, evidence that routing applies beyond the CLI (e.g., cloud/web sessions).

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have each task prompt automatically routed to the most suitable underlying model

citations.quote: Adaptive analyzes your prompt and routes it to the model that will deliver the best result.
Adaptive is an intelligent model router that automatically selects the best AI model for each task.
You can switch away from Adaptive to a specific model at any time with /model.
